html:
G'oya

Sentabrda xarid qilgan mijozlar bir to'plam, oktabrda xarid qilganlar boshqa to'plam. Ikkalasida ham bor mijozlar kerak, bu kesishma: INTERSECT. Kesishmani customer_id bo'yicha qilamiz, chunki ismdoshlar bor.

Yechim

SELECT id, name
FROM customers
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT customer_id FROM orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT customer_id FROM orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01'
)

Oy oralig'i "birinchi kundan boshlab, keyingi oyning birinchi kunigacha" ko'rinishida yozilgan. Bunda oyda nechta kun borligini o'ylash shart emas va 30-sentabr ham, 31-oktabr ham o'z oyiga tushadi.

Tuzoqlar

Ism bo'yicha kesishma ikki xil Azizni bitta odam deb hisoblaydi. Biri faqat sentabrda, ikkinchisi faqat oktabrda xarid qilgan bo'lsa ham, "Aziz" ikkala ro'yxatda bor va ikkalasi ham natijaga chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name
FROM customers
WHERE name IN (
  SELECT c.name FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT c.name FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-11-01'
)

ordersni ikki marta JOIN qilsangiz, sentabrda uchta, oktabrda ikkita buyurtma bergan mijoz 3 × 2 = 6 qator beradi. INTERSECT esa takrorlarni o'zi olib tashlaydi.

Boshqa yo'l

(id, name) juftligi bo'yicha kesishma ham to'g'ri: id har mijozni aniq belgilaydi.

SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
INTERSECT
SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31'

order_date faqat sana (DATE) bo'lgani uchun bu yerda BETWEEN xavfsiz. Ustunda vaqt ham bo'lsa, 31-oktabr soat 18:00 dagi buyurtma '2026-10-31'dan katta bo'lib, tushib qolardi.
